scripts.setup: bun install --cwd server --frozen-lockfile && bun install --cwd dashboard --frozen-lockfile
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd server typecheck && bun run --cwd dashboard typecheck
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.bundle: bun build server/src/mcp.ts --target=node --outfile plugin/dist/mcp.js && bun build server/src/hook-check-path.ts --target=node --outfile plugin/dist/hook-check-path.js && bun build server/src/cli.ts --target=node --outfile plugin/dist/cli.js
scripts.eval: cd server && node evals/answers.ts && node evals/multi.ts
